title: A Segmentation Fault can be trigerred in  torch._euclidean_dist

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: edge cases
labels.description: Adversarial inputs unlikely to occur in practice

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

A **Segmentation Fault** can be trigerred in `torch._euclidean_dist` with the following code:
````python
import torch
x1 = torch.rand([1, 1, 1], dtype=torch.float32)
x2 = torch.rand([0, 12, 5676819769219801604], dtype=torch.float32)
res = torch._euclidean_dist(
    x1=x1,
    x2=x2,
)
````
Output:
````
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
````
